*The [[Communist Party of China]] names former Secretary of the Secretariat [[Hu Jintao]] as its [[General Secretary of the Communist Party of China|General Secretary]], replacing [[Jiang Zemin]]. Jiang will remain [[President of the People's Republic of China|President]] until Spring 2003.
